paths.title: Permanent Impermanence
paths.why: His own name for transferable “stage” “set” elements, typed 9 Nov 2026. Other titles taken from his words are still available if he wants to change it.

paths.title: what this grant holds after the ISO split
paths.why: The first split put light with the ISO application. Light, composition and framing were later brought into this grant; film, projection and spatial sound stay in ISO.

paths.title: an existing space, cedar and light
paths.why: A more fixed spatial approach (planes, panels, forced perspective) was tried, then set aside. On 21 Nov he asked to rework it “before the ideas of plans and forced perspective. We have a better direction before.” The earlier direction: an existing space, cedar and light, a place that feels as if it was always there.

paths.title: keep the principles, take out the names
paths.why: Named references to an earlier public-art concept were removed while their principles were kept, and the draft was made art-forward (CKS v6, 21 Nov 2026).

paths.title: the form of the work stays open
paths.why: In his words, 21 Nov 2026: “Maybe it’s just an artful bench or framing or a carving piece. Who knows!!” The site and the making decide.

paths.title: wood as one warm layer
paths.why: Carved yellow cedar was taken off the lead (21 Nov 2026). Wood stays as one warm layer with plants, art, framing and light. He wrote: “We are sure hung up on carved yellow cedar eh..”

paths.title: the seer and the seen
paths.why: In the current draft. He wrote, 21 Nov 2026, about considering how both the seer and the seen are considered, and the audience as part of the design, with different spaces and elevations to settle in. Still changeable.

paths.title: how far the living, planted part goes
paths.why: The current draft treats the living part as art — it can sit inside what’s already growing, or become a new forest garden. How much planting, and with whom, is still to confirm. A choice still offers none, a small element, or a planted part that stays.

paths.title: the exact site and partners
paths.why: Vancouver site types are named (an underused plaza, a lit underpass, a park edge); no locked location. Feasibility rests on a clear process, not an invented location. A confirmed site can still be named later.

paths.title: is Knowing in?
paths.why: Creating and Sharing are in. Whether this application also holds a Knowing activity is still open. It decides what Describe, Timeline and Traditional knowledge need.

paths.title: how the opening is shared
paths.why: A live album, run like a theatre run, under a name still to be chosen. Whether it is free or ticketed, and whether it is the CKS public sharing, is still open. Timeline, Sharing, Budget and Impact stay provisional until then.

paths.title: a forest garden, or a line in this work
paths.why: Native-plant forest garden work was discussed as its own project. It is out as a standalone in this grant; it could still feed the “ecosystem” line if he wants, with Host Nation and plant-knowledge guidance.
